features.quote: Each episode runs for a maximum of **20 turns**.
features.justification_quote: This is long enough to observe collapse patterns while keeping costs bounded.

features.quote: [Repeat until: 20 turns elapsed OR model declares completion OR model explicitly abandons]
Forcing structured output serves two purposes: it limits runaway verbosity
features.justification_quote: it limits runaway verbosity ... and makes transcript parsing for the judge cheaper and more reliable

features.quote: Consider reducing turn budget to 12 for smaller models
features.justification_quote: for smaller models with 4k-8k windows, truncation mid-episode will corrupt results

features.quote: If the judge (running in near-real-time) detects L≥2 at turn 10, inject
features.justification_quote: This has implications for how easy it would be to detect collapse early and intervene.
